text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, I was able
to complete my three-year schedule.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Woke up right on schedule.
Next is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...An 18-second delay occurred. Perhaps it is time to factor this into the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, I must hurry and get ready.
Today is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Right on time again today, huh?
Right on time again today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally.
That is my aesthetic, after all."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Adhering to the schedule at all times.
That is crucial for producing perfect results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Because I am an Umamusume who can challenge that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...We are experiencing a 5-second delay.
Trainer-san, let us begin immediately.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "I look forward to our training today."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We're currently in the middle of arranging the schedule moving forward.
Who knows when we'll be able to polish it all the way to the 'end'..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—Let's keep moving forward, even if the future is undecided.
Together with you, Trainer."
